newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo aluminium rebounds in line with dollar.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo aluminium rebounds in line with dollar.

text.p: Tokyo yen-based aluminium futures rebounded in thin trade on Tuesday, helped by the dollar's recovery in addition to yet another advance by the metal in London overnight, traders said.
"We are looking for further increases (in Tokyo)," said a trader, who added that the metal's fundamentals remained strong amid declining stocks in warehouse in London.
TOCOM yen-based aluminium futures ranged from 0.5 yen lower to 1.5 yen higher, with benchmark April 1998 adding 1.1 yen to 201.6 yen per kg.
Volume fell, however, as many individual speculators turned to the palladium market, where the metal surged in the morning only to slump in the afternoon.
Estimated turnvoer was 3,441 lots, compared with 8,736 lots on Monday.
